claim: Code-MUE is a black-box uncertainty measure: Von Neumann entropy of an execution-based semantic interaction graph over N=100 sampled programs executed on K=20 probe inputs.
scope_conditions: HumanEval, MBPP200, QuixBugs, CodeNet200; eight LLMs; ISSTA 2026
quoted_support: Code-MUE grounds uncertainty in observable runtime behavior, calculating the Von Neumann entropy of the solution space to quantify global semantic diversity.

breadth.confidence_families: sampling-consistency over execution behavior (Sec 3-4); lexical, embedding, length, logit baselines (Table 2)
breadth.model_families_and_sizes: GPT-4.1-mini, GPT-4.1-nano, Claude-3-Haiku, Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite, Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, DeepSeek-Coder-6.7b etc. (Table 1)
breadth.base_vs_instruct: not present (searched: base, pretrained); instruct and code-specialized models mixed
breadth.elicitation_formats: no verbalized confidence evaluated; sampling at T=1.0 (Sec 7)
breadth.label_source: test execution (pass-all-tests); Solved if any of N passes (Sec 5.2.1)
breadth.label_independence: probe inputs used only to compare behavior, not generate labels (Sec 7)

claim: Evaluation excludes white/grey-box signals by design and compares only black-box multi-sample baselines (lexical, embedding, length, logit where available), so no probe-versus-verbal comparison exists.
quoted_support: We therefore exclude white-box or grey-box approaches that rely on token-level logits or internal activation states, as such signals are frequently inaccessible in commercial API-based services.

claim: Labels are problem-level: Solved if at least one of N sampled candidates passes all tests; correlation is with Pass@1. Benchmarks are HumanEval, MBPP200, QuixBugs, CodeNet200 with no release-date split; the text has no contamination discussion.
stance_target: L1: release-date contamination control not occupied
quoted_support: we assign each instance a binary label: Solved if at least one of the N N sampled candidates passes all tests, and Unsolved otherwise.
